CREATE TABLE "public"."Task" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "dueAt" timestamptz(6),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'MEDIUM' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'TODO' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Task_priority_check_8918b779" CHECK ("priority" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'URGENT')),
  CONSTRAINT "Task_status_check_217ccf21" CHECK ("status" IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'IN_REVIEW', 'DONE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TaskAssignee" (
  "assignedAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("taskId", "userId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TaskComment" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "ImageLink" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Workspace" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WorkspaceInvitation" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz(6),
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invitedBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'MEMBER' NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "WorkspaceInvitation_role_check_ddb31015" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'MEMBER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WorkspaceMember" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'MEMBER' NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "WorkspaceMember_role_check_ddb31015" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'MEMBER'))
)
